title: Observers Who Read Their Universe into Existence: Finite Consensus and the Reconstruction of Standard Physics
description: The authors propose Observer Patch Holography as a self-referential account in which observers recover and realize their world's rules. Finite comparisons and repairs establish shared records within the model. The abstract reports a finite consensus theorem, a three-direction slow response for a specified twelve-port carrier, and conditional links to gauge structure, quantum measurements, interacting finite energy levels, field theory and gravitational response. These results depend on stated mathematical structures and premises. Identifying the construction with the physical universe still requires a common interacting chiral 3+1-dimensional limit, the observed particle spectrum, responsive geometry and independent empirical agreement. The Introduction also distinguishes mathematical consistency from physical existence. This is a curated summary of the r2061 abstract and Introduction, not an independent verification of the paper's mathematics or physics.

methods.name: Finite consensus through comparisons and repair
methods.description: The authors model finite observers comparing overlapping records and repairing disagreements; the abstract reports a canonical consensus theorem (r2061 abstract).

methods.name: Conditional reconstruction from specified finite structures
methods.description: The paper relates a twelve-port carrier, supplied quantum structures and a specified finite source to gauge, measurement, field and geometric-response statements under declared premises (r2061 abstract and Introduction).

key_findings: The paper presents finite consensus and selected mathematical constructions within its proposed observer framework; catalog intake does not independently verify those results (r2061 abstract).
The authors distinguish a consistent mathematical construction from evidence that the construction physically exists (r2061 Introduction).

Identification with our universe remains conditional on an interacting chiral 3+1-dimensional limit, the observed particle spectrum, responsive geometry and independent empirical agreement (r2061 abstract).
